notes.title: Small Update
notes.content: [p]​Fixed some interactions between Explosion / Clock's Ticking and Can't See Me.[/p]

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content: [p]Can't See Me gets disabled if You'll Never Catch Me is active.[/p][p align="start"]Changed unlock requirement for Chaos modifier and Chaos Chaos sub-modifier.[/p][p align="start"]Made some QOL changes regarding Chaos modifier and Chaos Chaos sub-modifier.[/p]

notes.title: Modifier Update!!!
notes.content:
Redid the entire Modifier menu to make it more clean and organized! Also made slight tweaks to pre-existing modifiers.

Added in 18 sub-modifiers! Sub-modifiers are basically V2s of the current modifiers!

notes.title: Huzzah! (April Fools)
notes.content: You survived the Evil Cube invasion! Good Job!

notes.title: Uh Oh (April Fools)
notes.content: Evil Cube's are invading the game. Can you survive their endless attack? RUNNNNNNNNNNNNN!

notes.title: Shop Update!!!
notes.content:
Added 14 new skins to the game!!!

Added Colorblind mode in the settings.

Fixed some bugs.

Added 4 new achievements!

notes.title: Bug Fix / Skin Unlock Requirement Change
notes.content:
Fixed a bug that allowed some skins to be unlocked with blood money on when its supposed to be off.

Removed camouflage modifier from The Creator skin unlock requirement.

Changed The Beast skin unlock requirement.
